stem: Two genetically similar plants are the same height, but one is producing clear reproductive floral structures while the other is producing only new leaves and shoots. Which distinction is best supported?
choices: They must be at the same developmental stage because height is equal
The first shows reproductive development while the second remains primarily vegetative
The second must be male because it lacks visible flowers
Height alone proves the first plant is older
rationale: Developmental stage is interpreted from organ development and reproductive morphology, not from height alone.
